CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

2. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   B. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

6. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   B. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.

14. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
